Bitcoin Cash explorer documentation
Blocks, transactions and addresses

Search a block height, block hash, transaction ID, Bitcoin Cash address, or supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash may belong to several chains; manual chain selection stays available.

Bitcoin Cash targets one block every 10 minutes. ASERT adjusts mining difficulty after each block. The block subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks.

1 BCH = 100,000,000 satoshis. Fee rates use sat/B. Fiat values use the provider's Bitcoin Cash prices and may lag the market.

Privacy and coverage

Address history supports CashAddr and legacy Bitcoin Cash addresses. BCH amounts do not describe CashToken balances: token metadata and input quantities may be unavailable, and each affected view identifies that limitation.

The pending view shows a bounded provider sample, not a complete global mempool. Different nodes may see different transactions. Estimates are not confirmation guarantees.

Read-only API

Requests use the same local origin. Successful retained responses carry X-BCH-Observed-At and X-BCH-Stale headers. Provider failures return 503; absence returns 404. This local review does not broadcast transactions.

GET /api/block-height/500000
GET /api/block/:block-hash/txs
GET /api/tx/bcf7ae875b585e00a61055372c1e99046b20f5fbfcd8659959afb6f428326bfa

About bch.tx.taxi

bch.tx.taxi is the Bitcoin Cash explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, mining activity, fee estimates, and the live Bitcoin Cash mempool while using a Bitcoin Cash-specific tx.taxi identity.

Bitcoin Cash data

1 BCH equals 100,000,000 satoshis. Fees use satoshis per serialized byte: BCH has no SegWit weight discount. CashAddr and legacy addresses refer to indexed Bitcoin Cash history. BCH uses ASERT difficulty adjustment each block, a 600-second target and 210,000-block subsidy halvings.

Coverage

Mining charts show the latest 15 indexed blocks. Hashrate is estimated from observed work and elapsed time. Mempool charts reflect this session’s observations of one node, not a global pool. CashTokens are separate from BCH amounts; their raw category, units and NFT commitments are shown when present.

Infrastructure

The explorer reads public Bitcoin Cash network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.
